statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed for the weekend; Stress remains high on Friday’s hawkish rate repricing and unresolved Hormuz reopening risk.
recommendation: Weekend conditions provide no live NQ path to establish persistent one-way continuation. The published state therefore reflects low Tail with high headline and reopening-gap Stress.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Hormuz and hawkish rate repricing sustain Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend. Friday’s Nasdaq fell 0.52% after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight, while fresh Reuters reporting says Iran will maintain Strait of Hormuz restrictions. With no live futures path, these developments raise Stress more than Tail; shared Finviz context is older than 90 minutes and excluded.
